subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic-native compaction be exposed through Anthropic model parameters or through a new global `agents.defaults.compaction` provider mode?
rationale: The runtime gap is established, but these choices create different public configuration contracts and ownership boundaries; repository policy favors provider-owned behavior while the issue proposes a global config shape.

options.title: Anthropic model parameters
options.body: Keep controls provider-specific in model params and implement them through the Anthropic plugin wrapper and native transport.

options.title: Global compaction provider mode
options.body: Add a cross-provider mode under `agents.defaults.compaction`, accepting the broader config and compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Anthropic model parameters
recommendation.body: Keep controls provider-specific in model params and implement them through the Anthropic plugin wrapper and native transport.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns recent provider-plugin boundary work and already identified this exact public-configuration decision in the issue discussion.
